paths.title: Claude Intermediate
paths.tagline: Turn Claude from a chat window into a professional system: Projects, Artifacts, Skills, research and quality control.
paths.description: Go beyond single conversations. In twelve hands-on lessons you'll build on-brand Projects, reconcile multi-document evidence, ship interactive Artifacts, package workflows as Skills, run structured deep research, and master advanced prompting with output contracts. Then you'll apply it all to real work — meetings, long-form content, CSV analysis — and finish with the disciplines that make AI output trustworthy: memory and conversation strategy, verification passes, and a cross-surface workflow spanning web, desktop, mobile and Claude in Chrome.
